_doc: FAIL scenarios expected on the MOCK lane for documented reasons unrelated to the commit. check_known_findings.py makes the gate trustworthy: a run REGRESSES only when a scenario NOT listed here FAILS, or a listed one now PASSES (a fix — remove it). Only FAIL is regression-eligible; BLOCKED (couldn't drive: unreachable/@wip/content-driven/early-bail) and SKIP never flag and need no entry here. Keep a one-line reason per id.
